newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Ericsson propels Swedish shares to record close.
newsitem.headline: Ericsson propels Swedish shares to record close.

text.p: The Stockholm bourse barreled past a five-day old record to close at a new high on Friday after telecoms giant Ericsson rocketed six percent.
The general market index jumped 1.08 percent to 2,159.43 in lively turnover totalling 5.05 billion crowns.

Ericsson traded at record high levels throughout the session, gaining more on news Goldman Sachs put the firm on its priority list, an upgrade from market outperformer. The share closed at a an all-time high of 190 crowns, up 11.50.
Foreign investors were heavy buyers of the share in the wake of several days of muted interest for Microsoft and Motorola, brokers said.

"It was unbelieveable today. There seems to be no limit to the buy side -- turnover of 1.4 billion crowns and they say there will be as much in the U.S. today and the same amount in Stockholm on Monday," one broker said.
"With this kind of demand for Ericsson the upturn can easily continue on Monday, something to give the index more support."
Astra lost some gains made early in the session, but fell as Ericsson took centre stage, closing up only one crown at 307.
Cyclical shares made no broad significant moves. The forestry sector index rose 0.62 percent.
